decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of the original planning permission referenced P/2025/1786 which was granted permission on 31/08/2025.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: Transport Statement, Design and Access Statement, 1405-201 Rev. P02, 1405-301 Rev. P02, 1405-001 Rev. P02, 1405-002 Rev. P02, 1405-003 Rev. P02, 1405-004 Rev. P02, Planning Statement, Part B � Project Details and System Specifications, Cover letter, 0710438-HLE-XX-GF-GA-E-100053, Luminaire Schedule Stage 3, Irrigation System Schematic Outline Specification, BFL001, Biodiversity Metric Calculations, Ecological Impact Assessment, Drainage Assessment Form, Existing Site Plan Existing Drainage Works, Proposed Site Plan Existing Drainage Works, Greenfield Runoff Rate Estimation Tool. � received 6th June 2025
Response to Pre-Commencement condition on Contamination prepared by Macgregor Smith ref. 1405-G524 dated 8th September 2025, 1405-501 Rev. P02, 1405-502 Rev. P02, 1405-503 Rev. P02, 1405-001 Rev. P02, Covering letter � received 12th September 2025.
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.
Condition : 3 - The landscaping details shown on the submitted plans and documents shall be carried out as approved. 

The works shall comply with the requirements specified in BS 3936 (1992) 'Specification of Nursery Stock Part 1 Trees and Shrubs', and in BS 4428 (1989) 'Recommendations for General Landscape Operations'.

The details shall include (proposed finished levels or contours; means of enclosure; car parking layouts; other vehicle and pedestrian access and circulation areas; hard surfacing material; minor artefacts and structures (e.g. furniture, play equipment, refuse or other storage units, signs, lighting etc.); proposed and existing functional services above and below ground (eg drainage power, communications cables, pipelines etc. indicating lines, manholes, supports etc.); retained historic landscape features and proposals for restoration, where relevant). Soft landscape works shall include (planting plans; written specifications (including cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment); schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate; implementation programme).

All landscaping comprised in the approved details shall be carried out during the first planting and seeding seasons following completion of construction works or first occupation. Any trees or shrubs planted (including any such replacements) which die within five years from the date of planting shall be replaced in the next planting season with the same species, and of comparable maturity. The development shall be maintained in accordance with the approval.

Reason: In order to ensure a satisfactory appearance of the site and the area.
Condition : 4 - Prior to occupation the additional cycle parking spaces as shown on the approved plans shall be provided on-site and shall be retained thereafter.
Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives.
Condition : 5 - The proposal shall be implemented in accordance with the approved Biodiversity Metric Calculations and Ecological Impact Assessment in order to achieve a 75.15% net gain in habitat units above the existing situation.
Reason: In order to ensure a satisfactory appearance of the site and the area and to promote biodiversity.
description: Removal of land quality conditions 6 (Preliminary Risk Assessment), 7 (Intrusive Site Investigation), 8 (Remediation Method Statement / Remediation Strategy), 9 (Additional / Unexpected Contamination), 10 (Verification and Validation of Remedial Work) and 11 (Long Term Monitoring and Maintenance) of planning permission P/2025/1786 approved 31/08/2025 for the creation of new landscaped amenity space within part of existing car park at Lakeshore business park, Bedfont Lakes with associated hard and soft landscaping, street furniture and infrastructure.
